* At least 60 [[miner]]s are trapped underground following an explosion in a [[gold mine]] in [[Camilo Ponce Enríquez Canton|Ponce Enriquez]] in southern [[Ecuador]]. [http://www.ctv.ca/servlet/ArticleNews/story/CTVNews/20071126/mine_explosion_071126/20071126?hub=TopStories (AP via CTV)]
* The [[Romania]]n [[nationalist]] [[Greater Romania Party]] is voted out of the [[European Parliament]] in the [[European Parliament election, 2007]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/7113834.stm (BBC)]
* [[Chadian Civil War (2005–2010)]]: [[Chad]]'s army claims to have killed hundreds of [[Rebellion|rebel]] fighters in heavy fighting near [[Sudan]]'s [[Darfur]] region. [http://uk.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idUKL2655724720071126 (Reuters)]
* 35 [[Insurgent|militants]] are killed in a ground offensive against pro-[[Taliban]] militants by the [[Pakistan Army]].{{Fact|date=December 2007}} 
* The [[Federation Council of Russia|Federation Council]] of [[Russia]] sets March 2, 2008 as the date of the [[Russian presidential election, 2008]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/7112642.stm (BBC)]
* At least three people die and 45 are injured in [[Indonesia]] following [[earthquake]]s off the coast of [[Sumatra]] and [[Sumbawa]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071128084715/http://voanews.com/english/2007-11-26-voa5.cfm (VOA)]
* Former [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Prime Minister]] of [[Pakistan]] [[Nawaz Sharif]] announces he will file [[nomination]] papers in the [[Pakistani general election, 2008]]. However, he will not serve as [[Prime Minister]] under the current [[President of Pakistan]] [[Pervez Musharraf]]. * The [[People's Republic of China]] signs a deal to buy 160 [[Airbus]] aircraft in a deal worth [[United States dollar|$US]]17 billion during a visit by the [[President of France]] [[Nicolas Sarkozy]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20121030144226/http://biciforum.org/ (AFX via Forbes)]
